primitives.name: Pose Heatmap Encoding

Early-fusion embeds pose heatmaps directly into RGB channels, while late-fusion maintains separate pathways until final concatenation. The use of multi-head attention allows for dynamic weighting of modalities, enhancing robustness. Mathematical duality emerges in how early vs. late fusion map to different functional spaces—early fusion maps to a higher-dimensional input space, whereas late fusion preserves modality-specific representations. Failure modes include overfitting due to small dataset size and poor pose estimation leading to unreliable inputs. The model's reliance on precomputed poses implies that any drift in pose detector performance will propagate into classification errors.
